scope: All 222 open issues; bodies and available comments reviewed. Closed issues excluded.

classification_definition.design: New capability, alternative behavior or product-policy choice; no independently established broken contract is the whole request.
classification_definition.mixed: A bug and a separable design proposal coexist; track the decisions separately.
classification_definition.bug: Report of existing behavior failing its expected contract, regardless of upstream enhancement label; not a claim of current reproducibility.
classification_definition.maintenance: Build, release, support-matrix or contributor-infrastructure work outside this product-design shortlist.
classification_definition.documentation: Documentation publication, accuracy or discoverability work.
classification_definition.unclear: Insufficient evidence to separate missing capability, usage/setup and a defect.

recommendations_status: Proposed for Tauride planning; not accepted requirements, implementation estimates or changes to upstream triage.

recommended_first_specs.proposal: Name each interpreter input/busy state in the status bar.
recommended_first_specs.why: Makes an existing state signal understandable; specify concise wording and accessible text.

recommended_first_specs.proposal: Give Log and About consistent selection, Copy and Find actions.
recommended_first_specs.why: Treat as one reusable text-view behavior; preserve the existing Copy All path.

recommended_first_specs.proposal: Add dismissible first-use APL input help and a direct route to full symbol documentation.
recommended_first_specs.why: Improves entry and discovery without changing keyboard semantics; verify existing help before adding UI.

recommended_first_specs.proposal: Keep toolbar visibility configurable and expose its current state under View.
recommended_first_specs.why: The discussion supplies valid uses for hiding it; removing the preference would sacrifice that workflow.

recommended_first_specs.proposal: Add a thread-ID title placeholder using interpreter status already received.
recommended_first_specs.why: A bounded extension; define behavior before connection and when no thread ID is available.

design_families.name: Help and diagnostics
design_families.decision: Use consistent, searchable and selectable diagnostic text; make symbol-entry help discoverable without recurring interruption.

design_families.name: Commands and menus
design_families.decision: Choose a shared command model, context-sensitive availability and platform conventions before rearranging menus or toolbars.

design_families.name: Keyboard input and editing
design_families.decision: Define precedence among glyph entry, completion, indentation and shortcuts; specify overwrite and PF-key semantics independently.

design_families.name: Settings themes and colours
design_families.decision: Separate portable preferences from machine-specific state and define versioned import/migration before changing storage or colour formats.

design_families.name: Session state and text
design_families.decision: Distinguish visible session text from interpreter-owned history and print width; define where authoritative namespace, thread and prompt state comes from.

design_families.name: Workspace and source files
design_families.decision: Define workspace loading versus source-file opening, saving and association, including which machine owns files in remote sessions.

design_families.name: Debugging
design_families.decision: Separate stack inspection, movement of the next line and execution; verify interpreter capabilities before adding controls.

design_families.name: Windows and sessions
design_families.decision: Set docked/floating behavior, window discovery, sizing and session lifecycle together; do not inherit Electron workarounds automatically.

design_families.name: Rich output
design_families.decision: Define output rendering, window reuse, update identity and printing scope before expanding HTML/SVG or demo behavior.

design_families.name: Distribution and platform support
design_families.decision: Choose supported targets and update notification policy; separate shell support from interpreter display requirements.

consolidation_candidates.action: One tracing-options design for skipping blank, comment and local-declaration lines.
One overwrite-mode design; keep overstrikes (#317) a separate decision.
One source-file Save/Save As workflow, designed with opening/association (#935).
Unify retained-session colouring; distinguish syntax colouring from input/output role colouring.
One stack-navigation design covering source access, frame selection and interpreter capability.
One selection-to-search command with URL encoding and discoverable shortcut/menu access.
One context-display vocabulary for namespace/thread/caption; namespace switching is an additional feature.
Portable preferences, schema/migration, theme files and storage locations need a coherent compatibility plan.
Resolve visibility/discoverability together; do not implement both removal and a new toggle independently.
Consolidate window discovery/grouping; reassess the proposed macOS floating-window removal against Tauri's existing process model.
One common diagnostic-text interaction, with separate acceptance checks for Log and About.

issues.title: On Windows, the names of open editors should appear at the bottom of the Window menu
issues.ask: List open editors in the Window menu for quick switching.
issues.rationale: Adds a navigation surface; discussion extends the request to Mac RIDE 4.5.
issues.decision: Use one open-window list with active-window indication and reliable activation.
issues.evidence: 2023 comments extend scope to Mac and link #986; fork src-tauri/src/menu.rs:118 already registers the macOS windows menu, so verify the remaining Windows scope. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/35#issuecomment-1589206657

issues.title: RIDE should check for updates automatically
issues.ask: Check automatically for available RIDE updates.
issues.rationale: A new update-discovery workflow; the issue contains no body or discussion.
issues.decision: Choose notification-only checks, frequency, release channel and an explicit opt-out.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/36

issues.title: Autocomplete path-names when calling user-commands
issues.ask: Complete file paths in user commands such as ]load.
issues.rationale: Requests extending completion from system commands to user commands.
issues.decision: Identify file-taking command arguments and retain local/remote interpreter path semantics.
issues.evidence: Interpreter work recorded as Mantis 15729. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/71#issuecomment-383065615

issues.title: Add list of recently opened wss to File-Menu
issues.ask: Expose recently opened workspaces in the File menu and completion.
issues.rationale: Adds a shortcut to repeated workspace loading; comments suggest numbered entries and )load/)copy suggestions.
issues.decision: Define history scope per connection and whether selecting an item inserts or executes a load command.
issues.evidence: Comments explicitly pair #212 and propose keyboard-accessible 1–9 history. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/77#issuecomment-384911650

issues.title: Workspace Explorer does not show :sections
issues.ask: Show :Section structure in Workspace Explorer.
issues.rationale: A parity request for structural navigation, with no failed existing behavior described.
issues.decision: Decide whether sections belong in the object tree or only the editor outline.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/97

issues.title: Mac: Cmd+q appears to quit APL but can leave "invisible" background process running.
issues.ask: Ensure quitting a spawned busy interpreter does not leave an invisible CPU-consuming process.
issues.rationale: Reproducible resource-lifecycle defect; later interpreter fix covered only weak-interruptible execution.
issues.evidence: 17.0.31160 partially fixed exit, but strong-interrupt-only loops remained. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/136#issuecomment-336846870

issues.title: Feature request: associate .dws files in OSX with RIDE
issues.ask: Open .dws files from Finder in RIDE.
issues.rationale: New desktop file association and workspace-launch workflow.
issues.decision: Select default interpreter and new-session versus current-session behavior, including latent-expression consent.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/147

issues.title: Newbie-friendliness: integrate more ODE-Options into RIDE-Menu!
issues.ask: Expose ordinary workspace actions through discoverable menus and possibly a toolbar.
issues.rationale: Newcomers cannot find Save/Load; the unrelated slow-tracer discussion was addressed separately.
issues.decision: Define a small command set and whether menu actions prepare commands or immediately execute them.
issues.evidence: Detailed menu proposal covers Save/Load/New and session options; unrelated focus-performance report received a fix. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/157#issuecomment-299162826

issues.title: RFE: Smarter Editor Prompting
issues.ask: Offer semantic dfn indentation and optional closing-brace prompting.
issues.rationale: Explicit optional editing-assistance enhancement beyond the referenced indentation defect.
issues.decision: Decide opt-in indentation rules separately from inserting braces or moving the cursor.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/159

issues.title: Mac RIDE should have more standard menu items
issues.ask: Provide standard macOS Hide, Hide Others and Show All items.
issues.rationale: Requests conventional native application-menu capabilities.
issues.decision: Retain native platform roles for these standard actions.
issues.evidence: Fork src/prf.js:86–88 declares all three items; src-tauri/src/menu.rs:39–41 maps them to native predefined actions. Source inspected at 15f1452a; no runtime verification.

issues.title: RIDE should set ENABLE_CEF to 0 when using SSH
issues.ask: Avoid initializing display-dependent CEF when launching a headless interpreter over SSH.
issues.rationale: An environment compatibility failure is the motivation; comments debate where to detect a display, not a new user feature.
issues.evidence: Body states CEF needs a display; comments prefer interpreter auto-detection but lack a Mac detection method. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/204#issuecomment-318015771

issues.title: New feature: File->Open to load a workspace
issues.ask: Load a workspace through File → Open.
issues.rationale: The requested local menu action was implemented; debate remains around protocol use, remote scope and command visibility.
issues.decision: Keep existing local Open; scope any remote file picker and command-preview behavior as explicit follow-on decisions.
issues.evidence: 2017 comment says menu added; fork src/prf.js:92 gates Open to local sessions and src/km.js:139 handles .dws with LOAD/XLOAD confirmation. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/212#issuecomment-337220150

issues.title: WIBNI Reformat was a menuitem/context menuitem or toolbar item
issues.ask: Make the existing Reformat menu action work in floating editors.
issues.rationale: Original menu request is implemented; the latest comment narrows the outstanding problem to broken floating-window dispatch.
issues.evidence: 2024 comment distinguishes working docked menu, broken floating windows and separate context-menu #1021; fork src/prf.js:97 has Reformat. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/217#issuecomment-2220173130

issues.title: display HTML inline in the session
issues.ask: Render HTML results inline in the session.
issues.rationale: Proposes a different output presentation and interaction model.
issues.decision: Define inline output sizing, lifetime, trust boundary and transcript/export behavior.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/229

issues.title: a better way of skipping lines in the tracer
issues.ask: Allow skipping directly to a selected tracer line without executing code.
issues.rationale: The keyboard and context-menu interaction were implemented; remaining discussion concerns protocol efficiency and wrap semantics.
issues.decision: Keep Skip to line, and resolve target validity and boundary behavior before replacing repeated BK/FD messages.
issues.evidence: Context menu confirmed in 2018; fork src/km.js:435–443 registers Skip to line. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/230#issuecomment-385979264

issues.title: Workspace Explorer shows expand symbol (+) on empty namespaces
issues.ask: Do not show an expandable node for an empty namespace.
issues.rationale: Reports an incorrect affordance; lazy loading explains the missing information but does not make it a feature request.
issues.evidence: Maintainer suggests child count/empty flag or one-level prefetch. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/250#issuecomment-390115780

issues.title: Workspace Explorer shows ⓝ icon for instances
issues.ask: Visually distinguish class instances from ordinary namespaces.
issues.rationale: Discussion establishes the existing namespace icon is technically correct and ⓘ means Interface; this is an icon taxonomy choice.
issues.decision: Choose distinct accessible instance symbols without overloading Interface or relying on subtle letter case.
issues.evidence: Maintainers reject the initial bug interpretation and debate case-sensitive icon sets. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/253#issuecomment-337200027

issues.title: Language bar: emphasise grouping a bit more
issues.ask: Make symbol groups visually distinct and prevent breaks within groups.
issues.rationale: Requests grouping, wrapping and discoverability improvements, with differing views on user customization.
issues.decision: Preserve meaningful nonbreaking groups; decide labels and user-reordering policy separately.
issues.evidence: Comments propose labelled groups and separate group/subgroup wrapping. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/267#issuecomment-337863699

issues.title: Make common actions available as a toolbar
issues.ask: Offer a toolbar for common editing and workspace actions.
issues.rationale: Adds a discoverable action surface for newcomers and users unfamiliar with remapped shortcuts.
issues.decision: Choose a small configurable toolbar and its relationship to the language bar and menus.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/274

issues.title: WIBNI we had named "themes" of configuration settings
issues.ask: Support reusable named configurations and portable theme settings.
issues.rationale: New profile-switching workflow; comments add import/export across machines.
issues.decision: Separate full environment profiles from colour-scheme import/export and define which machine-specific fields transfer.
issues.evidence: Discussion requests daily/demo/screen-size profiles and portable colour schemes. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/276#issuecomment-353581285

issues.title: Enable overstrikes
issues.ask: Support traditional APL overstrikes in overwrite mode.
issues.rationale: Adds an alternative character-entry method that the IDE supports.
issues.decision: Make overstrike composition optional and define its relationship to overwrite mode.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/317

issues.title: Allow user to use a dead key as the prefix key if they want to
issues.ask: Make dead keys reliable prefix keys for APL entry.
issues.rationale: Requests support for an input method whose platform composition behavior is not currently reliable.
issues.decision: Specify composition-event handling and consistent suggestion behavior for dead-key prefixes.
issues.evidence: Maintainer confirms events arrive but Windows suggestions and Mac replacement differ. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/329#issuecomment-374275371

issues.title: MacDyalog needs a way to query the session window height and width
issues.ask: Let APL query the session dimensions in characters and pixels.
issues.rationale: Introduces a client-geometry protocol capability needed by ]rows.
issues.decision: Agree window identifiers, pixel/character units and response behavior after resize.
issues.evidence: Explicit duplicate #232; proposed GetClientRect/ReplyGetClientRect contract. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/378#issuecomment-389902877

issues.title: WIBNI: DM demo system: conditional display and execute of lines
issues.ask: Let demo scripts independently control displaying and executing each line.
issues.rationale: New scripting controls; comments call for compatibility with ]demo.
issues.decision: Reuse ]demo escape conventions and define whether display-only text is persisted in the interpreter log.
issues.evidence: Execute-without-display requires protocol work; client-only display would not enter interpreter log. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/404#issuecomment-389494134

issues.title: Workspace explorer icons background colours are too harsh
issues.ask: Use a calmer, readable colour palette for workspace object icons.
issues.rationale: Aesthetic and accessibility tradeoff; no broken type semantics are established.
issues.decision: Select contrast-tested theme-aware colours while retaining text as a redundant type cue.
issues.evidence: Discussion contrasts scanability, visual prominence and colour meaning. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/410#issuecomment-390161541

issues.title: Pressing <tab> at the end of the line has no effect.
issues.ask: Restore useful Tab behavior when completion has no candidates at line end.
issues.rationale: Maintainer identifies a regression introduced by shell-style completion; comments debate repair semantics.
issues.evidence: Regression and proposed immediate soft-tab fallback documented; a user values no-motion failure feedback. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/431#issuecomment-395955360 The corresponding frontend fix is merged in Tauride main 15f1452a; see docs/reopened-issue-validation.md and docs/prs/36.md through 41.md. This does not establish every historical variant resolved.

issues.title: Make 4454⌶ work in Ride
issues.ask: Allow APL tooling to prefill the IDE search field through 4454⌶.
issues.rationale: Adds interpreter-driven editor control; maintainers explicitly dispute this architectural direction.
issues.decision: Decide whether a narrow supported IDE automation API belongs in the product before exposing this I-beam.
issues.evidence: Maintainers oppose APL driving RIDE, while the tool author describes practical Fire integration. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/440#issuecomment-396885448

issues.title: Commenting and un-commenting selected lines should be available from the context menu
issues.ask: Expose comment and uncomment actions in the context menu with shortcuts.
issues.rationale: Adds discoverability for existing editing commands.
issues.decision: Place both actions in the editor context menu and derive displayed shortcuts from user mappings.
issues.evidence: Issue body requests context actions and shortcuts; fork src/km.js:295–296 already defines AO/DO commands. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/446

issues.title: Feature request: show current namespace in a status bar
issues.ask: Show the active namespace and optionally allow switching it.
issues.rationale: New contextual status display, title variable and navigation affordance.
issues.decision: Ship an always-correct namespace indicator first; separately define namespace-picker scope and switching semantics.
issues.evidence: Comments request {NSID} and point to #1396. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/447#issuecomment-738804994

issues.title: In the tracer FD wraps but BK doesn't
issues.ask: Choose consistent end-of-function behavior for tracer BK/FD navigation.
issues.rationale: Requests changing long-standing intentional asymmetric behavior; no new defect mechanism is established.
issues.decision: Prefer stopping at both boundaries, subject to interpreter agreement and nested-dfn scope rules.
issues.evidence: Discussion says ODE asymmetry was deliberate but rationale forgotten; references Mantis 14716. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/450#issuecomment-396877281

issues.title: Stand alone editor
issues.ask: Provide an APL-aware editor mode without starting an interpreter.
issues.rationale: A distinct offline editing workflow with different window and navigation needs.
issues.decision: Define supported files, syntax services available offline and how users transition into a live session.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/483

issues.title: Insert key should switch to overwrite mode
issues.ask: Toggle insert and overwrite modes with Insert.
issues.rationale: Requests an editing mode missing from the underlying editor at the time.
issues.decision: Define overwrite indicators, selection behavior and accessibility before binding Insert.
issues.evidence: Comment links Monaco/VS Code overtype support limitations. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/512#issuecomment-453544750

issues.title: Interrupts are generally ignored in Quote-Quad Input
issues.ask: Honor weak and strong interrupts during quote-quad input.
issues.rationale: Interrupts are ignored or delayed despite existing control semantics.
issues.evidence: Repro and platform differences in body; 2022 comment says it awaits #888. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/514#issuecomment-1181499010

issues.title: RIDE always shows status window
issues.ask: Honor suppression of automatic status popups and define user control over them.
issues.rationale: Existing 2036⌶ behavior is ignored; discussion adds a separable client preference and disputes whether it overrides interpreter state.
issues.decision: Keep client Auto Status control and decide how explicit interpreter suppression interacts with it.
issues.evidence: Fork src/prf.js:14 and src/ide.js:976 implement client Auto Status; this does not establish I-beam parity. Debate: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/529#issuecomment-479864743

issues.title: Ambiguity in File > Open menu
issues.ask: Clarify supported Open file types and prevent misleading missing-file prompts.
issues.rationale: The requested picker guidance is a design change; comments separately report repeated false file-not-found prompts after opening a shortcut.
issues.decision: Offer meaningful type filters with an all-files escape hatch and explicit file-versus-workspace behavior.
issues.evidence: 2019 comment reports three unnamed missing-file prompts; 2022 comment links #886. Fork src/km.js:147 still uses empty filters. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/530#issuecomment-483989644

issues.title: WIBNI: Search for a term on specified site with keyboard shortcut
issues.ask: Search a configured website for the selected token using a shortcut.
issues.rationale: New customizable help/search routing beyond built-in F1 behavior.
issues.decision: Use URL-encoded selection templates with a defined fallback for an empty selection.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/545

issues.title: shortcuts to delete a character, a word, to eol
issues.ask: Expose additional editor actions to shortcut and PF-key customization.
issues.rationale: Users patch the command registry to obtain word movement/deletion and discuss Vim support.
issues.decision: Expose a documented stable command set first; treat full modal editing as separate scope.
issues.evidence: Maintainer confirms only registered commands can be assigned; later comment proposes monaco-vim. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/556#issuecomment-550242521

issues.title: WIBNI, like the IDE, when you click on a line in the SIStack window, the tracer window showed that function
issues.ask: Navigate the tracer to a stack frame by clicking its SI Stack entry.
issues.rationale: Adds direct stack-to-source navigation, particularly valuable with one tracer window.
issues.decision: Define frame selection, current execution marker and single-window reuse without resuming execution.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/583

issues.title: WIBNI RIDE supported SVG javascript animations
issues.ask: Support script-driven SVG animations in 3500⌶ output.
issues.rationale: Requests expanding viewer capability from static output to scripted SVG; body shows blank animated content but no prior script-support guarantee.
issues.decision: Specify supported active SVG behavior and isolation consistently for native and browser clients.
issues.evidence: Body supplies a SharpPlot SVG using onload and script; fork src/ide.js:857 loads native HTML from a file but browser mode uses innerHTML, so current behavior needs verification. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/584

issues.title: 3500⌶ should create a new window at every call
issues.ask: Allow several 3500⌶ output windows to coexist and be updated individually.
issues.rationale: Changes output-window lifecycle; comments explicitly prefer backward-compatible handles over always spawning windows.
issues.decision: Introduce explicit create/update handles and decide behavior when a referenced window has closed.
issues.evidence: Discussion proposes dyadic window handles and preserving monadic replacement behavior. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/588#issuecomment-658166935

issues.title: 3500⌶ doesn't use <html><head><title> as window caption
issues.ask: Use an HTML document title as its output-window caption.
issues.rationale: Reports valid HTML title metadata being ignored in the existing viewer.
issues.evidence: Body provides a title-element repro; fork src/ide.js:881 uses protocol x.title or a generic fallback rather than parsing the document title. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/589

issues.title: Allow atomic items on the menu bar
issues.ask: Allow one-click actions directly on the menu bar.
issues.rationale: Extends menu configuration into a toolbar-like interaction.
issues.decision: Prefer a coherent toolbar command surface or explicitly support top-level actions across native menu conventions.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/594

issues.title: `selection` variable in menu
issues.ask: Expand {selection} in configurable menu URLs.
issues.rationale: A new parameterized search action, overlapping the site-search shortcut request.
issues.decision: Specify URL encoding, selected-text extraction and fallback to token under cursor.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/596

issues.title: Add support for documented commands
issues.ask: Make the documented list of supported commands match what RIDE actually supports.
issues.rationale: Maintainer treats unimplemented commands as possible future enhancements and explicitly agrees to correct the guide.
issues.evidence: Last comment promises a documentation issue after the supported-command claim is challenged. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/597#issuecomment-673534904

issues.title: ^ isn't treated as ∧ in idioms
issues.ask: Highlight the ^ aliases of recognized ∧ idioms consistently.
issues.rationale: Specific syntax-recognition defect; discussion records a fix followed by a 4.5 regression.
issues.evidence: Modern idiom list comes from interpreter; 2023 comment confirms regression. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/604#issuecomment-1589186842

issues.title: Support syntax highlighting of JSON(5) and XML
issues.ask: Detect and syntax-highlight JSON, JSON5 and XML with a manual override.
issues.rationale: Adds editing language modes and mode selection.
issues.decision: Define detection thresholds and per-buffer overrides without changing APL editing defaults.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/619

issues.title: Pasting extremely large lines results in infinite loop of "INPUT LIMIT" alerts
issues.ask: Stop oversized pasted input from producing an endless INPUT LIMIT alert loop.
issues.rationale: An unbounded error-dialog cycle is a concrete failure, reproduced on 4.4.
issues.evidence: Reporter confirms the same repro on RIDE 4.4. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/634#issuecomment-1143486127 The corresponding frontend fix is merged in Tauride main 15f1452a; see docs/reopened-issue-validation.md and docs/prs/36.md through 41.md. This does not establish every historical variant resolved.

issues.title: Ride needs to work on its speedwriting
issues.ask: Keep large-output rendering and long session histories responsive.
issues.rationale: Reports CPU stalls and loss of input responsiveness; log caps and paging are mitigation ideas rather than the original feature intent.
issues.evidence: 2022 optimization commit cited but large-history memory and responsiveness remain concerns; LF conversion proposal was rejected as interpreter-owned. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/639#issuecomment-1220538226

issues.title: RIDE on Windows does not show in the All Apps List after being installed
issues.ask: Make installed Windows RIDE appear in the All Apps list.
issues.rationale: Installer integration is missing despite a successful installation and searchable application.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/669

issues.title: Missing "Allow session above edit and trace windows" config option
issues.ask: Allow the session to appear above floating edit and trace windows.
issues.rationale: Requests optional window-stacking behavior available in ODE.
issues.decision: Define parent/child and always-on-top rules per platform, with a clear user preference.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/716

issues.title: Running ride as different (non-root) user with sudo on Debian 10 and Mint 20.1 causes an abort
issues.ask: Avoid aborting when launching as another non-root Linux user.
issues.rationale: A concrete application startup abort; root cause may include display/session permissions.
issues.evidence: Body includes sudo-user launch and futex abort; Electron-specific repro needs reevaluation in the Tauri fork. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/730

issues.title: Fresh install on Debian 10 asks for chrome-sandbox to be made setuid
issues.ask: Ensure a fresh Debian installation can start without sandbox-permission errors.
issues.rationale: Package fails at first launch due to chrome-sandbox ownership/mode.
issues.evidence: Body includes dpkg install and fatal SUID sandbox error; specific Chromium helper does not establish a Tauri requirement. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/731

issues.title: AC (Align Comments) is broken
issues.ask: Prevent Align Comments from corrupting code and choose how standalone comments are aligned.
issues.rationale: Comments provide repeated-AC code mangling; the original request separately changes which comment-only lines alignment should touch.
issues.decision: Align trailing comments by default and include standalone comments only through an explicit selection rule.
issues.evidence: 2022 repro produces doubled comment glyphs and increasingly mangled code. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/745#issuecomment-1141869825 Tauride main 15f1452a includes the explicit-selection rule and regression tests in tests-node/editor-commands.js; native verification is recorded in docs/prs/39.md.

issues.title: Option to syntax highlight past lines in REPL
issues.ask: Optionally keep syntax highlighting on prior REPL input.
issues.rationale: Body explicitly describes existing behavior as intentional and asks for an option.
issues.decision: Preserve input/output provenance and allow syntax-coloured prior input without treating arbitrary output as APL.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/748

issues.title: Inquiry: Bringing in printer options
issues.ask: Explore printing session or editor content.
issues.rationale: A roadmap inquiry, explicitly not a concrete feature request; maintainer says no plans existed.
issues.decision: Establish the printing use case and desired content before committing a print UI.
issues.evidence: User explicitly says this is a question rather than request; maintainer confirms no prior plan. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/782#issuecomment-940375327

issues.title: When deleting a block from the session log, only text content is removed, while the lines themselves remain
issues.ask: Make Delete Block remove selected session-log lines correctly and persistently.
issues.rationale: Advertised deletion empties lines and activates unrelated input; persistent deletion needs protocol support, not a new independent feature.
issues.evidence: Client deletion repair cited in 2022; proper persistent DK remains RFE20011 and #33 was consolidated here. https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/798#issuecomment-1219189237

issues.title: File>Save/Save As… missing from menu
issues.ask: Save an edited APL item to a text file through Save or Save As.
issues.rationale: Adds discoverable source-file export/save workflow rather than merely fixing an existing menu action.
issues.decision: Distinguish fixing an object in the workspace from saving source, including local/remote destination and file format.
issues.evidence: Issue body: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/799

issues.title: Enable the current thread Id to be included in the Window Title
issues.ask: Allow the current APL thread ID in the configurable window caption.
issues.rationale: Adds a new supported placeholder; an unsupported literal token is not evidence that an existing token is broken.
issues.decision: Define TID update events, which thread is current, and the disconnected/unknown value, then expose it with other caption substitutions.
issues.evidence: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/1386 — requests {TID}; src/ide.js:1060–1090 substitution map has PID and PROFILE but no TID. Existing InterpreterStatus includes TID (docs/protocol.md); the title substitution map in src/ide.js currently omits it. This does not require inventing a new protocol field.

issues.title: Save path of interpreters on SSH connections as you do for local session
issues.ask: Remember the last interpreter path for each SSH launch profile.
issues.rationale: Maintainer says this existing capability works in the same version and requests the reporter configuration; this is a suspected persistence defect rather than a missing general feature.
issues.evidence: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/1387#issuecomment-3996989816 reports working persistence; #issuecomment-4004608570 confirms the reporter uses SSH launch rather than attach.

issues.title: Function line numbers don't show in a namespace script while editing

The corresponding frontend fix is merged in Tauride main 15f1452a; see docs/reopened-issue-validation.md and docs/prs/36.md through 41.md. This does not establish every historical variant resolved.

issues.title: Remove minimum window height/width
issues.ask: Remove or relax minimum session window dimensions.
issues.rationale: Changes an intentional usability constraint to support smaller windows; no malfunction beyond the constraint is reported.
issues.decision: Choose responsive behavior and minimum usable content size, including connection/preferences dialogs, before removing hard limits.
issues.evidence: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/1389 — explicit request to remove constraints; Tauride native session builder has no min size, but frontend window sizing has constraints and layout needs checking before declaring fulfilled.

issues.evidence: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/1390 — issue body; no substantive clarification in comments.

issues.title: An exception in a message handler can permanently freeze the inbound message queue

issues.evidence: https://github.com/Dyalog/ride/issues/1417 — timer-path reproduction; fork docs/prs/37.md records finally-based reset/continuation and native subsequent-message validation, without claiming all historical triggers are fixed.
